entities.summary: Shigetaka Kurita (b. 1972-05-09, Gifu Prefecture) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Gifu Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
